sections.content: The owner, in conversation with Claude Code, 2026-10-30; recorded verbatim. Answer to ask A1 on srs-context PR #121: should the memory stats live as a generated file (bench/results/stats.md) or as records with a Stats composition inside srs-context (options: generated file / records and a composition / do nothing). The one-word answer is kept as said; its reading is open.
